title: VP recognition for three years of hackday progress
summary: The vice president of IBM India Software Labs recognized me in his board meeting for the lab's steady growth in hackday participation over three years.
the_call: Keep building the lab's hackday program year after year.
what_i_did: Organized and led the lab's hackdays from 2008 to 2010.
what_changed: Named in the VP's board meeting on 22 March 2011.
